Commentary.Commentary: That's all we have from this entertaining game. The second ODI is on Thursday, 18th August at 2.30 pm IST (9 am GMT). Do join us in advance for the build-up. Cheers!

Babar Azam, the captain of Pakistan, says that they are relieved to get the win and credits the Netherlands for their fight. He calls Fakhar's knock lovely as the pitch was two-paced. Mentions that they took time to build a partnership. Admits that they should have done better with the ball. Tells that he loves to play here as the conditions are challenging.

Scott Edwards, the captain of the Netherlands, says that it hurts to lose another game but feels they are getting closer. Regrets dropping catches and praises the knock of Fakhar Zaman. Mentions that the pitch suited the home team. He is happy with the way they batted and feels that the overs at the backend with the ball cost them. States that they let themselves down in the field after showing improvement in the recent past. He is happy with the bowling performance of Bas de Leede.

Player of the Match is Fakhar Zaman (109). He calls it his lucky day and tells that the wicket was not easy. Praises the Dutch team for their bowling. Feels that they should have done better and credits Netherlands for putting up a fight. Mentions that they were looking to survive initially and then went after the bowlers. Says that he always enjoys batting with Babar Azam and batting looks easy with him around.
Stay tuned for the presentation...

The Pakistan players began with absolute fire and Babar Azam started with the combination of the experienced Haris Rauf and the young debutant Naseem Shah. Both picked up one wicket each in the Powerplay and could probably have got a few more had their fielders held on to the catches. Pakistan were really poor on the field and that prevented them from being clinical and wrapping this game up early. Mohammad Nawaz controlled the middle overs of the game and was economical, picking the only wicket taken by a spinner in the whole game. Haris Rauf picked up three wickets but was a touch expensive and Naseem Shah bowled wonderfully to take three wickets. The biggest issue was the number of extras they conceded with 29 bonus runs added to the Dutch total. They eventually managed to close the game out but will know there is room for improvement in all three departments of the game.

The arrival of the Dutch skipper Scott Edwards, who has had a wonderful summer, kept the hosts on track. He translated his good form to bring up his fourth consecutive ODI fifty. Scott was ably supported by Teja Nidamanuru and Logan van Beek to keep the Netherlands in the hunt. Although the target seemed out of reach, they did well to play out the 50 overs and pushed Pakistan to the limit.

In pursuit of a big target, the Dutch team began tentatively but kept accumulating runs at a steady rate albeit in a streaky manner. Max O'Dowd and Wesley Barresi departed early to leave the Netherlands with quite an uphill task. Vikramjit Singh had a tough outing as he just could not get the spinners away or rotate the strike freely. He survived several drop catches and accumulated many lucky runs but eventually succumbed for 65 having faced 98 deliveries. While he seemed to be blowing cold, Tom Cooper definitely seemed to be blowing hot and provided the much-needed boost to the Netherlands innings. He took 54 deliveries for his 65 and his dismissal brought an end to a 97-run partnership between the two.

Well fought, Netherlands! Well fought, Scott Edwards! They made Pakistan sweat hard for this win. It was not a straightforward win for the visitors, as expected. This performance will certainly boost the confidence of the Dutch team and they will back themselves to cause an upset in the next game. For now, Pakistan bag the 10 points to make their case strong in the 2020-2023 ICC Cricket World Cup Super League table.
PAKISTAN WIN BY 16 RUNS! Slower again, short and around leg, Scott Edwards hits it down to fine leg and takes a single.
MISFIELD AND FOUR! Full and around leg, slower in pace, Edwards whips it to deep backward square leg. Khushdil makes a mess near the fence and concedes a boundary.
Fuller in length, around leg, Dutt clears his front leg and drills it down to long on for one.
Pace off, a touch short and on off, Scott tries to power it over the leg side but misses. Rizwan fumbles and they cross for a bye. All over now for Netherlands.
Back of a length, on middle, Scott heaves it over mid-wicket and gets two runs. 24 needed off 4 balls.
Swing and a miss! Full in length and just outside off, Edwards gets across and tries to slog but is early into the shot. The slower one deceives him there.
FOUR! Slower one, short and wide outside off, Dutt finds the room and slaps it over covers for a boundary. 26 needed off the last over and Scott Edwards will be on strike.
Yorker in the blockhole, Aryan cannot do much and just digs it out back towards the bowler. Hang on, Shah has overstepped. Free Hit coming...
Slower one, short and wide outside off, Edwards runs it down to third man for a single.
Slightly short and outside off, Scott walks across the stumps and pulls it wide of short fine leg. Takes two.
Turns a length ball through square leg and hands the strike back to his skipper.

Run out chance missed! Naseem goes very full and on middle, Dutt somehow keeps it out to mid-wicket and Edwards comes out of the crease in search of a run. He is sent back and would have been run out had the fielder scored a direct hit at the bowler's end.
Aryan Dutt makes his way out to the middle and he needs to rotate the strike.

OUT! LBW! Naseem spears in a full inswinging delivery, around middle at 88 mph. Tim Pringle fails to keep it out and is thudded on the pads. The appeal is made and the finger goes up. Tim Pringle takes the DRS but it's of no use. He is plumb in front, confirms the Ball Tracking.
Tim Pringle is the new batter at the crease and he will look to give the captain the strike.

OUT! Logan van Beek holes out! The pressure was mounting, and Logan tries to find the boundary but perishes in the process. Shortish and around off, van Beek heaves it over square leg but doesn't get the connection right. Khushdil Shah takes a simple catch in the deep. 35 needed off 12 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c Khushdil Shah b Haris Rauf

Commentary.Commentary: Hits the hard length around off, Logan hits it from the inner half of the bat to deep mid-wicket and returns for the second run.
Slower one, full and on middle, Edwards keeps it out towards square leg and crosses. This is impressive death bowling from Pakistan.
A yorker around leg, van Beek digs it out to mid-wicket and crosses.
Fuller and around off, Logan van Beek drags his attempted heave towards wide long on. Gets only two. The Dutch team needs boundaries.
A touch short in length, around middle, Scott heaves it to deep square leg for a single.
Fuller and around leg, it's eased down to fine leg for one. Fantastic over. Just 6 runs coming off it. 42 needed off 18 balls.

Fuller in length, around middle and leg, van Beek tries to flick but misses. It goes off his pads to backward point and they cross for a leg bye. The 50-run stand comes up, off 40 balls. These two have kept the Netherlands in the game.
Called a wide for height! Slower bouncer, outside off, Logan van Beek tries to pull but misses. A touch harsh on the bowler. That's just above the shoulder.
Another slower one, on a length and outside off, Logan slogs it over mid-wicket and gets a couple.
Swing and a miss! A 75 mph delivery, short and outside off, Logan is way too early into the shot and misses. Clever.
Spears it in, full and around off, at 88 mph, Edwards helps it to mid-wicket and takes a single.
Clever change in pace. Naseem bowls a slower bouncer, around off, Edwards walks across the stumps and tries to pull but misses.

Slight halt! That looked like it hit hard but Scott Edwards is smiling. The physios are checking on him now and he looks absolutely fine. They are checking the helmet and it seems like it needs to be replaced. The new helmet has been brought out and we are set to resume play. Naseem Shah (8-0-37-2) has been asked to bowl now.
Bangs it in short, around off, Edwards tries to pull but misses. It pings him on the helmet and deflects to covers. They cross for a leg bye. 11 from the over, 48 needed off 24 balls.
FOUR! Cheeky! Fuller in length, around leg at 83 kph, Scott Edwards shuffles across the stumps and spoons it over short fine leg for a boundary.
A reverse-swinging yorker around off, 85 mph, van Beek digs it out to mid off and picks up a single.
Play and a miss! Mohammad Wasim goes length and delivers it outside off, Logan van Beek throws his bat at it but fails to connect.
FOUR! Tonk! Slower one, short and outside off, Logan van Beek picks the length early, judges the pace well and hammers it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Angling down the leg side, on a fuller length, Scott tries to flick but misses. It goes off his pads to short fine leg and they cross for a leg bye.
Mohammad Wasim (8-0-45-1) has been brought back into the attack.
Short and outside off, turning away, Logan slaps it to sweeper cover for two. 7 from the over, 59 needed off 30 balls.
Floated delivery, full and around off, Scott brings out the reverse sweep and sends it to deep point for a single.
Flighted and around off, fuller in length, it's swept to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller and around off, Logan advances down the track for a big heave over the leg side but scuffs his shot off the bottom edge.
Full and around off, swept to deep square leg for a single.

Floated delivery, full and on middle, Edwards helps it on the leg side and sets off for a non-existent single. Shadab collects the ball to his right, has a shy at his end but misses. The batters end up getting two. A direct hit would have been curtains for Edwards. He has a fifty now but he's eyeing a win here for his team.
Lands it on a length, slower in pace, Edwards plays it down to point and retains strike with a single. 66 needed off 36 balls.
Back of a length, around off, van Beek turns it behind square leg and presses hard for two. Gets only a run.
Short in length around off, Scott drags his attempted pull shot through square leg for a single.
Slower one, full and around off at 75 mph, Edwards picks the variation late and only manages to defend it back towards the bowler.
Back of a length outside off, Logan pushes inside the line and edges it down to third man for a run.
FOUR! Superb shot! Rauf pitches it up and around off, Logan van Beek drives it crisply past the diving extra cover fielder and it races past mid off for a boundary.
Slightly short and on off, Logan works it to square leg for a run. A good over by Naseem, only 5 from it. 74 needed off 42 balls. Netherlands need a big over here!
A leg-stump half-volley, Edwards clips it in front of square on the leg side for a single.
Fuller and on middle, knocked down to long on for a run.
Short and around off, staying low, Edwards adjusts well and pulls it down to fine leg for one.

Around middle, on a good length, Logan helps it down to fine leg for a run. Edwards turns for the second run but is sent back. Rizwan attempts a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Babar Azam does the back-up and seems to have hurt his fingers. Initially, he was seen going off the field but then decides to stay back.
Short in length, around off, van Beek plays a mistimed pull shot to short mid-wicket.
Back of a length, around off, Scott tries to run it down to third man but misses. 10 from the over, 79 needed off 48 balls.

A length ball around off, Edwards pushes it a bit uppishly but wide of the bowler. They cross for a run as the mid off fielder sends a wayward throw at the bowler's end. The batters cross for an overthrow as well.
Beaten all ends up! Sharp delivery, full and outside off, Scott goes nowhere with his footwork and tries to drive. It tails back in and beats the inside edge of his bat.
FOUR! Gloved away! Short in length, around middle and leg, Edwards tries to pull but it takes his gloves and flies past the keeper for a boundary at fine leg.
Full and around off, Scott plays late and deflects it past the diving point fielder for two runs again.

Near collision between the batters but there is no harm done. Sliding down the leg side, it's tickled down to fine leg and they cross for a run. Both batters nearly run into each other while going for the second run. The throw from the deep is a poor one and Scott makes it with a dive.
Haris Rauf is back into the attack now. He has conceded 34 runs in his 6 overs and taken two wickets.
Fullish and around off, pushed out to the off side. Straight to point. End of a terrific over by Shah. 89 runs needed in 54 balls.
FOUR! Streaky! The bowler did nothing wrong there. He hit the blockhole, van Beek squeezed it out off the outer edge and the ball raced away to the third man fence.
Angles it in, on a length around off, van Beek defends it by getting on the front foot.

Given lbw! But Logan van Beek has decided to review the decision. Coming to the delivery, it's a sharp inswinging yorker on middle, tailing in and is too good for a new batter. Logan van Beek fails to keep it out and is pinged on the front pad. The finger goes up and Logan van Beek is advised by his skipper to take the DRS. The UltraEdge finds no edge but the Ball Tracking shows that it's MISSING THE STUMPS. Logan van Beek survives.
Logan van Beek strides out to the middle. Naseem Shah seems to be having some trouble with his back. He is stretching it out and it just seems like cramps. He is okay to continue.

OUT! Drags it on! Naseem Shah strikes to break a dangerous stand. Fuller in length and outside off, at 86 kph, Teja Nidamanuru tries for a booming drive through the line but only manages an inside edge onto the stumps. The wickets are shattered and Pakistan will feel a lot easy now. 93 runs needed in 58 balls, four wickets left!
Short in length and outside off, Edwards reaches out and steers it down to third man. He asks his partner to push but only gets a single.
Powerplay 3! Pakistan can place five fielders outside the inner circle for the last 10 overs. Naseem Shah (6-0-27-1) has been brought back into the attack.
Some reverse in the air. Full and tailing in a hint around off, Teja pushes it down to mid on. The Netherlands need 94 runs in 60 balls, Pakistan made 99 in their last 10 overs. Game on?
Outside off, dabbed down to third man for a run.
Slips a full ball around leg, Teja Nidamanuru fails to flick and it goes off his pads to the on side. They cross for a leg bye.
Back of a length, around off, tapped down towards cover-point for one.
Fuller and outside off, crunched to deep cover for a couple. The 50-run stand comes up, off 44 balls.

FOUR! Netherlands are putting pressure on Pakistan. Full in length and angling down the leg side, Edwards tickles it behind and Rizwan gets a bad bounce as it scoots past him to the fence at fine leg. Given as leg byes.
Flatter and quicker on middle, it's nudged wide of short fine leg for two. 103 needed off 66 balls.
Fuller and around middle, clipped to square leg for one.
Shadab Khan goes full asking Scott Edwards to go for the sweep again, Scott Edwards chooses to flick this towards deep square leg for a brace.
Shadab Khan continues bowling full, Scott Edwards goes for the sweep but does not connect this time.

FOUR! Reverse swept this time! Shadab Khan bowls full once again and in line with the stumps, Scott Edwards is down on his knees and mirrors his shot to the off side. The ball races to the deep backward point fence for four more runs.

FOUR! Scott Edwards is getting his sweep shot out to display! Shadab Khan floats this full outside off, Scott Edwards goes across the off side and sweeps this towards deep backward square leg for four runs.
Mohammad Wasim flights this full and bowls this outside off. Teja Nidamanuru works this to mid off.
Mohammad Wasim goes full and just outside off, Teja Nidamanuru flicks this to deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Full this time and angling into the pads, Scott Edwards clips this towards deep square leg for a single.
Mohammad Wasim bangs one in short and angling down leg, Scott Edwards looks to pull but misses.
Bowls it on a good length once again and outside off, Scott Edwards guides this to backward point and looks for a single. Sent back by Teja Nidamanuru.
Mohammad Wasim bowls this on a good length and angling into the batter. Scott Edwards clips this towards mid-wicket.
Flighted once more and bowled full outside off, Teja Nidamanuru goes forward and smothers the ball to the off side.
Shadab Khan floats one full and outside off, Teja Nidamanuru strokes this straight to extra cover.
Shadab Khan bowls this a fraction short outside off, Scott Edwards moves to the off side and works the ball to mid-wicket for another single.

Shadab Khan bowls a loopy delivery full and angling into the stumps, Teja Nidamanuru clips this uppishly towards mid-wicket and rushes for a run. The fielder collects on the bounce and throws at the non-striker's end. Teja Nidamanuru has given up and would have been gone if there was a direct hit.
Flights this full outside off, Teja Nidamanuru knocks this towards cover.
Shadab Khan bowls this full and in line with the stumps, Scott Edwards flicks this towards deep square leg for one run.
Mohammad Wasim ends the over with a full delivery angling down leg, Scott Edwards clips this to fine leg and takes one.
Mohammad Wasim bowls this short and outside off, Teja Nidamanuru pulls this towards deep mid-wicket. The ball does not have the legs to reach the boundary and they take three runs.
Mohammad Wasim continues bowling full and outside off, Scott Edwards strokes this to mid off and takes a quick run.
WIDE! Bowls this full and straying down leg. This is called wide by the umpire.
Mohammad Wasim bowls this on a good length and gets the ball to nip back in. Hits high on the pads and there may have been an inside edge.

Shout for an lbw, not given! Pakistan decide to review the decision. A length ball around off, angling in, Teja Nidamanuru fails to work it around and is rapped on the pads. They appeal but the umpire shakes his head. The Ball Tracking shows that it's clipping the leg stump. The on-field decision stays.
Mohammad Wasim bowls this on a good length and just outside off, Teja Nidamanuru plays this towards mid off.
Goes on the back foot and helps it through square leg for one.
Top edge but safe! Flighted and around off, this time Scott top-edges his slog sweep and it falls safely at deep mid-wicket. They cross.
FOUR! Fine shot! Fuller and around off, Edwards gets down and across before sweeping it through square leg for a boundary. Netherlands need 131 runs in 92 balls!
SIX! Into the crowd! Loopy and full, around middle, Scott Edwards kneels down and smokes it in front of square on the leg side for a biggie.
Skidding in from around off, Teja goes back and turns it wide of short fine leg for one.

Loopy and full, around off, Teja pushes it with an angled bat to point. Scott wants a run but is sent back and he dives in to reach the crease. Had the fielder hit the stumps at the bowler's end, the Dutch skipper would have been a goner.
Pitches it up and outside off, Scott drives it down to mid off. Dot ball to end a tidy over.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and blocks it back.
EDGED BUT SAFE! A touch short in length and outside off, Edwards rocks back to cut but gets an under-edge. It dips in front of the keeper who grabs it and then signals that it has not carried.
Spears it in full, around off, Edwards pushes it out to covers.

Slight halt! The groundstaff is out there putting some sawdust on the foothold at the non-striker's end. Naseem Shah seems to be clearing his spikes as some part of the soil came off while he was delivering the previous ball. All done and we are set to resume.
Short again, outside off, this time Teja plays it down to third man and rotates the strike.
Short in length and wide outside off, Edwards reaches out and cuts it down to third man for a single.
Short in length and outside off, Edwards goes back and punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Loopy and full, around off, Scott plays the reverse sweep but finds backward point.
On the pads, tickled to short fine leg for one.
Fuller and on leg, it's eased behind square leg for a quick couple of runs. A better throw would have Teja Nidamanuru in trouble.
Quicker and flatter, around off, Teja punches off the back foot to covers.

DRINKS! The players will take a break. Tom Cooper and Vikramjit Singh put on a good partnership for the fourth wicket but both have been dismissed now and with half their side in the dugout, it does look really difficult for the hosts. The Pakistan spinners controlled the middle phase of the game by keeping it tight. They will now be looking to end this game as soon as possible. Teja Nidamanuru is the new batter and will join Scott Edwards in the middle.

OUT! LBW! Loopy and full, landing around middle, Singh goes down to sweep but misses and is rapped on the pads. They appeal and the finger goes up. Vikramjit Singh consults his partner and takes the review. The UltraEdge shows that there is no bat and the Ball Tracking finds everything in line. Three reds and Singh departs for his highest score in ODIs. Both the set batters are dismissed and the Netherlands will have to start from scratch. 148 needed off 107 balls.
Around off, on a length, Singh taps it down to covers and steals a single. Netherlands need 148 runs in 108 balls!
A little short in length around off, Scott Edwards bunts it down towards mid on and picks up a single to open his account.
Slightly short in length and outside off, Scott rocks back and plays it down to point. Finds the fielder.
Full in length around middle, Vikramjit gets across the stumps and flicks it through square leg for a run.
Shout for a caught behind, not given! Sharp delivery. On a length around middle and skidding off the surface, Singh plays all over it and it whistles past the inside edge to the keeper.
FOUR! Chinese cut past the stumps! A length ball around middle, Singh tries to defend with a straight bat but gets an inside edge past the stumps to the fine leg fence.
Naseem Shah (4-0-18-1) is back into the attack. He has been impressive so far on his ODI debut.
In the channel outside off, on a good length, Edwards leaves.
Width outside off, short in length, it's slashed down to third man for a single.
Back of a length, around off and following the batter inside the crease, Singh tries to play late but it takes the bottom edge and drops in front of the keeper.
Fuller and around off, defended back.
Scott Edwards, the captain of the Netherlands makes his way out to the middle after the end of a good partnership.

OUT! CAUGHT! The breakthrough has come and Pakistan are delighted. Rauf darts in a length ball around middle, at 90 mph, Cooper tries to flick but closes the face of his bat early. It balloons in the air off the leading edge and Babar Azam takes the simplest of catches at mid off. Rauf roars in delight. The dangerous Tom Cooper has been dismissed and the 97-run stand is also over. 156 needed off 118 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c Babar Azam b Haris Rauf

Commentary.Commentary: Short outside off, punched to deep point for one.

FOUR! This has been slapped away! Mohammad Wasim goes short and outside off, Tom Cooper rocks back and pulls the ball to deep mid-wicket for the third boundary of the over. 14 runs from this over and the Netherlands are looking to go for the target now.
Shorter this time and wide outside off, Vikramjit Singh slashes this to deep point for a single.

Mohammad Wasim bowls this on a good length and outside off, Vikramjit Singh hits this straight to covers who does well to stop it. Tom Cooper comes out of the crease in search of a run but is sent back. Agha Salman misses his shy at the bowler's end and Cooper survives.
This is a fraction short as well and outside off, Tom Cooper works this to deep backward point for a run.
FOUR! Make that two in a row! Mohammad Wasim bowls this back of a length and outside off, Tom Cooper gets low and cuts this towards deep point to get another boundary. 150 up!
FOUR! Tom Cooper is looking to go after the pacers! Mohammad Wasim bangs this in short and angling down leg, Tom Cooper pulls this towards deep backward square leg for a one-bounce four.
Mohammad Wasim (4-0-18-1) is also back into the attack.
Goes back to bowling on a good length. Vikramjit Singh punches this towards mid on. 11 runs from this over.

FOUR! Vikramjit Singh gets this one away to the boundary! Haris Rauf bangs this in short and outside off, Vikramjit Singh goes well across to the off stump and helps the ball along to fine leg for four runs.
Haris Rauf bowls this on a good length and angling into the batter. Tom Cooper knocks this towards mid on and takes a quick run.
Haris Rauf goes 'round the wicket to the left-hander and bowls a yorker in line with the stumps, Vikramjit Singh shuffles across and clips the ball to fine leg for a single.
Haris Rauf serves this one full and angling into the pads, Tom Cooper clips the ball towards deep square leg for a run.

FOUR! Tom Cooper brings up his fifty and unlike Vikramjit Singh, his knock is full of intent. Short in length and on middle, Cooper stands tall inside the crease and pulls it powerfully down to long leg for a boundary. It nearly went all the way. Tom needs to last the distance if the hosts want to dream of an upset win here.
Phew! There is a bowling change. The last few overs from the spinners ticked off very quickly. Here is Haris Rauf...
Agha Salman tosses this one full and in line with the stumps, Vikramjit Singh defends this back to the bowler.
Full and angling into the pads, Tom Cooper knocks this towards long on for a run.
A delivery that straightens after pitching is served outside off, Tom Cooper feels for it and is beaten.
FOUR! Tom Cooper is getting a move on here! Agha Salman flights this one, lands short and outside off, Tom Cooper drags this towards deep mid-wicket and gets a boundary.
This is short and wide outside off, Vikramjit Singh goes back in the crease and cuts it to deep point for a single.

FIFTY FOR SINGH! Dropped thrice and Vikramjit Singh has done well to raise his half century. Fetches a full ball from outside off and sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs. He needs to accelerate now.
Shadab Khan floats this one full and outside off, Vikramjit Singh goes for the sweep to deep sqaure leg and takes a run to keep strike.
Delivers this full and turning into the pads from middle, Vikramjit Singh clips this towards mid-wicket.
Shadab Khan bowls full this time outside off, Tom Cooper strokes the ball to long off for a run.
Shadab Khan serves this short to compensate and bowls this outside off, Tom Cooper cuts this towards point and a great stop from Babar Azam saves a certain boundary.
SIX! Dispatched! Cooper has decided to up the ante. Loopy delivery, full and around off, Cooper uses the long extension of his arms and dismisses it over long on.
Fuller and around off, pushed to the right of the cover fielder for a single.
Agha Salman strays on the pads on a fuller length, Vikramjit Singh clips this to deep backward square leg for a single.
A fraction short and outside off, Vikramjit Singh cuts this straight to the point fielder.
Full on the pads, Tom Cooper works this to deep square leg for a single.
Bowls a full toss in line with the stumps, Tom Cooper punches this back to the bowler.
Bowls this full on the pads, Tom Cooper looks to work this leg side but misses. It hits the pads and roles to square leg.
SIX! Tom Cooper finally dispatches one out of the park! Agha Salman bowls this full and outside off, Tom Cooper sweeps this well over deep backward square leg for a biggie!
Loopy and around middle, fuller in length, Singh gets forward and gently helps it to mid-wicket.
Short and outside off, punched to sweeper cover for a single.
Tossed up, around off, Singh plays the reverse sweep and places it towards backward point for one.
Fullish and on middle, knocked down towards mid-wicket.
Fuller and close to leg, Singh gets across the stumps for the paddle shot but misses.
Slightly short and on middle, Singh goes on the back foot and plays it down to mid-wicket.
Fires it in, full and around off, Singh tries to flick but closes the face of his bat early. It goes off the leading edge to backward point and they take one.
Fullish and on middle, Cooper tickles it through mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
Flighted and full, outside off, it's driven back past the bowler to long off. They cross for another run.
Goes on the back foot and whips it with the spin to deep square leg. A single.
The length is short again, outside off, Vikramjit Singh forces it to sweeper cover for one.
Shortish and around off, skidding in, Singh cuts but finds point.
Googly, around off, Singh eases it through cover-point for one.

Caught off a Free Hit! Short in length and outside off, Cooper cuts it aerially, with the spin, but there isn't enough timing to clear the sweeper cover fielder. He takes the catch and then returns the ball in play. Only a run. 100 comes up!
Fuller and on off, driven straight back to the bowler. Called a no ball for overstepping. Free Hit coming...
Short in length and outside off, turning away, Cooper cuts it to cover-point where the fielder makes a superb one-handed stop. Another dot.
Loopy and around off, Singh plays a lofted shot over mid on but it doesn't carry to the fielder in the deep. They cross.
Slightly short and on middle, Singh goes back and helps it to square leg.
Flighted and around off, pushed back defensively to the bowler.
Loopy and around middle, Cooper flicks but finds mid-wicket. Dot ball to end a tidy over from the debutant.
Fuller and on middle, Singh works it through mid-wicket for one.
Quicker this time, on the pads, it's nudged towards fine leg for a run.
Knocks a full ball down to long off and takes a single.

Dropped! Third chance put down by Pakistan offered by Singh. Short in length and outside off, turning away, Vikramjit Singh has a lazy waft at it and edges it towards covers. Imam-ul-Haq puts in a dive but fails to hold on.
A hint of turn there, full and around off, Cooper flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Agha Salman has been brought into the attack to see if he can get a breakthrough.
Quicker and shorter on off, punched to covers.
Leans forward to a full ball and defends it to the off side. He is just chewing up balls here and putting pressure on Cooper.
Flatter through the air, around middle, Singh goes on the back foot and defends it on the leg side.
A low full toss on middle, Tom knocks it down to long on for one.
Flighted and full, on middle, Cooper wrists it to mid-wicket.
Loopy and full, around off, it's driven back to the bowler who makes a fine half-stop.
Flatter arm ball around off, Cooper punches it down to long off for one.
Fires a full ball around leg, it's pushed down to mid on.
Mohammad Nawaz gets this in closer to the stumps on a fuller length. Vikramjit Singh works this towards long on and rotates the strike.
Fires this one in quicker outside off, on a fuller length. Vikramjit Singh is happy to defend this to the off side.
Mohammad Nawaz continues to flight this outside off, Vikramjit Singh pushes at it and gets a thick edge towards point.
Mohammad Nawaz starts with a full delivery outside off, Tom Cooper strokes this towards the long off fielder and takes one.
Fires this one full and into the stumps, Tom Cooper strokes this to long off for a run.
Full delivery outside off, Vikramjit Singh works this to deep point for a single.
Shadab Khan flights this one and tempts Tom Cooper to drive outside off, Tom Cooper works this wide of long off for another run.
Shadab Khan bowls this full and on middle, Tom Cooper clips this through mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy and full, around off, Cooper drives it with soft hands through covers and returns for the second run.
Gets on the front foot and drives a full ball back to the bowler.
Shortish and outside off, Singh goes back to cut but gets a bottom edge. It runs down to third man and they get two.

This could have been a chance! Mohammad Nawaz floats this one up, full and outside off, Vikramjit Singh strides forward to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads. The ball lobs up towards the vacant short leg region and falls just out of the reach of the keeper.
Pulls his length back a bit and in line with the stumps, Vikramjit Singh works this back towards the bowler.
Full delivery pitching outside off, Vikramjit Singh taps this ball to short cover.
Mohammad Nawaz bowls this short and outside off, Tom Cooper goes back in the crease and punches it to long off for a run.
Mohammad Nawaz bowls this full and on middle and gets the ball to turn into the pads, Vikramjit Singh clips it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A fraction short and in line with the stumps, Tom Cooper defends this back to the bowler.

Dropped! Short in length and outside off, Tom goes back to cut but gets a healthy outside edge to the keeper. Mohammad Rizwan gets very little time to react and it deflects off his gloves to the off side.
Goes back to bowling full outside off, Tom Cooper thumps this to deep cover and picks up a brace.
This is wide outside off and a fraction short. Tom Cooper cuts this to the right of point and the fielder dives to stop the ball.
Goes full once again and just outside off, Vikramjit Singh works this to long on and takes a run.
Shadab Khan begins with a full delivery on the pads, and Vikramjit Singh clips the ball to mid-wicket.
Shadab Khan is introduced into the attack.
Loopy delivery bowled full and really well outside off, Vikramjit Singh strokes this to deep cover for a single.
Mohammad Nawaz bowls this straight and just outside off on a fuller length. Vikramjit Singh defends this back to the bowler.
Continues bowling full and this time on middle and off, Tom Cooper moves to the leg side and works this towards long off for a run.
Mohammad Nawaz flights this one full and pitches on leg, Tom Cooper makes room and plays the ball to the bowler's right.
Mohammad Nawaz bowls this full and in line with the stumps, Tom Cooper defends this back to the bowler.
Mohammad Nawaz serves this full and angling into the stumps, Vikramjit Singh clips the ball to long on for a single.
A yorker outside off, it's dug out down to third man for a single.

A half-shout for a caught behind. A low full toss around off, dipping in, Vikramjit Singh tries to dig it out but fails. It goes past his bat to the keeper who collects the ball and appeals. Nothing from the umpire.
Fuller in length and outside off, Singh strokes it off the front foot to covers.
Close to off, on a shorter length, Cooper chops it down from the back foot to point and picks up a run.
Fuller and on off, driven firmly back towards the bowler who made a half stop and parried it behind to mid off.
FOUR! Superb shot! A length ball around off, Tom Cooper shows the full face of the bat and caresses it down the ground at long on for a boundary.

DRINKS! The Netherlands got off to a decent start scoring 56 runs in Powerplay 1 but the issue for them is that they are already three wickets down. The Pakistani pace bowlers have been outstanding with all three of them chipping in with a wicket each. This looks like a difficult chase for the Dutchmen as they require 247 runs in 36 overs. Pakistan will be looking for more wickets after the break.
Flighted and on off, Vikramjit Singh strides forward to play across the line but get a little leading edge and it rolls back to the bowler.
Beaten! This one skids straight on, after landing full outside off, and Singh lunges to defend but is beaten. He was playing for the spin.
Quicker this time, around off, once again Singh forces it on the leg side but finds the fielder.
Gets on the front foot to a full ball and helps it with the spin to mid-wicket.
Loopy deliver, full and drifting in around leg, Cooper eases it down to long off for a run.
Flatter and shorter outside off, Singh gets across the stumps and punches it down to long on for a run.

Brilliant stop in the deep by Haris Rauf. Length delivery outside off, Cooper strokes it elegantly through backward point and it races away. Rauf runs across to his right from third man, puts in a full-length dive, and stops the ball from touching the fence. Saves two.
The batter has just watchfully blocked this out.

Shout for an lbw but the umpire shakes his head. A low full toss on middle, angling in, Cooper tries to flick but misses. He is thudded on the pads but the appeal is not entertained. No review is taken as Pakistan feel there was an inside edge.
Angling in from around off, Cooper works it through square leg and opens his account with a couple of runs.
Tom Cooper makes his way out to the middle.

OUT! Dead plumb! No inside edge this time, Bas de Leede knows he is a goner and walks back. Mohammad Wasim hurls across a length ball, around off and nipping back in at 86 mph. Bas de Leede goes nowhere with his footwork and is caught inside the crease. He tries to work it on the leg side but misses and is rapped on the pads. They appeal and the umpire lifts his finger. This is a big blow to the Dutch team as Bas is their star batter. 253 needed off 226 balls.
Angles in a length ball around middle, de Leede clips it gently behind square leg and rushes back for the second run.
This one goes straight on, shortish in length outside off, it's pushed from the back foot to covers.
Tossed up outside off, landing full, Singh presses forward and blocks.
Spinning back in from around off, Singh plays around his pads and pushes it to mid-wicket.
Loopy and full, around middle, Bas walks forward and slices his drive through cover-point for a run.
Babar Azam comes at first slip.
Flighted and full, around off, defended off the front foot to covers.
Arm ball around leg, de Leede clips it off his pads to backward square leg.
Full delivery around leg, Singh plays it down to mid on and shots no.
Fuller in length and wide outside off, Singh plays a mistimed drive to covers.
Around off, on a length, Singh defends from the crease.
Outside off, steered down to deep backward point for one.
Taps a length ball down to point for a run. The fielder misses his shy at the bowler's end and with no one backing up, the batters gets one more.

Given lbw! This one looks out but Bas de Leede wants to review the decision. Coming to the delivery, it's full and around middle, angling down, Bas de Leede walks across the stumps and tries to flick but misses. He is rapped on the pads, they appeal and the umpire agrees. DRS time! The UltraEdge finds a clear spike and Bas de Leede survives.
Powerplay 2 time. A maximum of 4 fielders are now allowed outside the ring till the 40th over.

Mohammad Nawaz balls a loopy full toss in line with the stumps, Bas de Leede comes down the wicket and knocks the ball to long on for a run and will keep strike. The Netherlands are 56 for 2 after Powerplay 1.
Flights this one full and outside off, Vikramjit Singh knocks this wide of mid off and takes a run.
Mohammad Nawaz bowls short once again and gets the ball to turn in from outside off, Vikramjit Singh looks to cut but gets an inside edge into the pitch.

FOUR BYES! What a jaffa! Mohammad Nawaz is getting some sharp turn here! He flights this one, lands it a fraction short and outside off, Vikramjit Singh goes on the back foot to play this. Gets beaten on the inside edge and the keeper cannot collect. The ball runs away to fine leg for four byes.
Mohammad Nawaz flights this full outside off, Vikramjit Singh strokes this into the gap at deep cover-point. That brings up the fifty for the Netherlands.
Mohammad Nawaz begins with a full delivery on the pads, Bas de Leede goes back in the crease and works this towards square leg for a single.
Change from both ends. Mohammad Nawaz to bowl the final over of Powerplay 1.
Delivers this on a good length and on a leg-stump line. Vikramjit Singh taps this back to the left of the bowler.
Mohammad Wasim serves this on a good length and in line with the stumps, Bas de Leede clips this to deep square leg for a single.
Mohammad Wasim bowls this short and wide outside off, Bas de Leede misses out as he miscues his cut to covers.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and pushes it towards mid on.
Short and outside off, steered through point for two runs.
Four leg byes! Drifting down the leg side, the batter fails to flick and it goes off his thigh pad towards the keeper. Rizwan dives but fails to stop and it races away to the fence at fine leg.
Naseem Shah bowls this short and outside off, takes the pace off the ball. Vikramjit Singh mistimes his pull towards the vacant deep cover region and they take two.

NO BALL! Another Free Hit wasted! But wait a moment... he has overstepped once again! On a good length and outside off, Vikramjit Singh goes across and looks to play this leg side. He misses but there will be another opportunity for him.
Mohammad Wasim replaces Rauf from this end.
NO BALL! Naseem Shah goes full and on off, Vikramjit Singh fends this back down the pitch. The bowler has overstepped and the Netherlands now have a Free Hit.
This is wide outside off and on a shorter length. Bas de Leede works this towards deep backward point for a single.
Naseem Shah bangs in a bouncer going down leg, Bas de Leede leaves this one alone.
Back-of-a-length delivery outside off, Bas de Leede gets on his toes and works this towards deep point for a brace.
Naseem Shah bowls a quick delivery angled into the batter from a good length. Bas de Leede looks to work this leg side but misses and gets hit on the groin.
Bas de Leede is off the mark, finally! Naseem Shah bowls this full outside off, Bas de Leede strokes this to deep cover and they take a couple of runs.
Goes short and outside off, Vikramjit Singh swings but is beaten by the lack of pace on this delivery.
Bowls a good-length delivery on the pads, Vikramjit Singh defends this back towards the bowler.
Bowls this back of a length and outside off, Vikramjit Singh looks to play at this but gets beaten.
FOUR! This is a loose ball and gets the treatment! Haris Rauf strays down the leg side on a fuller length. Vikramjit Singh glances this to fine leg and gets a boundary.
Back of a length, around middle, defended back to the bowler.
Shortish and on off, played down from the back foot to point.
Wide for height! Pacy bouncer, well over the head of the batter. Mohammad Rizwan jumps and collects.
Short once again and going away from the left-hander. Bas de Leede looks to pull but misses.
Cannot make use of this Free Hit! Naseem Shah bowls a slower delivery, fuller and around off, Bas de Leede looks to heave but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
NO BALL! Naseem Shah goes back to bowling on a good length and outside off, Bas de Leede pushes this towards point. The bowler has overstepped though and it will be a Free Hit.
Bowls this back of a length and nipping back in from outside off, Bas de Leede looks to work this leg side but misses. Gets hit high on the thigh pad.
On a good length and just outside off, Bas de Leede looks to fend but gets an inside edge down to the leg side.
Bangs this one in short and angling into the batter. Bas de Leede sways out of the way and lets this one through to the keeper.
Naseem Shah bowls this on a good length and close to the off pole, Bas de Leede gets across the stumps and nudges the ball to mid-wicket.
Good-length delivery this time, and outside off, Vikramjit Singh mistimes his shot back down the pitch.
Haris Rauf strays onto the pads from a good length. Bas de Leede looks to work this leg side but misses. It hits his pads and rolls to backward square leg for a leg bye.
Goes full now and on middle, Bas de Leede flicks this to square leg. Another dot ball.
Haris Rauf goes back to bowling good length and outside the off stump channel. Good movement in the air and Bas de Leede leave this one alone.
Bas de Leede is in next.

OUT! TIMBER! The off pole goes cartwheeling out of the ground. Haris Rauf bows this a touch fuller and outside off, and gets the ball to nip back in sharply. Wesley Barresi reads the line and decides to offer no shot but the ball comes in to uproot his off stump. Pakistan have started wonderfully here and they have their second wicket.
Haris Rauf bowls this on a good length and in line with the stumps, Wesley Barresi clips this towards mid-wicket.

Dropped! In the channel outside off, on a length and angling away, Vikramjit Singh pushes at it and edges it towards second slip where the fielder, Fakhar Zaman, dives across to his right but fails to catch it. It sneaks down to third man where Khushdil Shah makes a sliding stop near the fence. Saves two.
Sharp delivery, on a length around middle, Wesley Barresi tries to flick but closes the face of his bat early. It goes down to third man off the leading edge and they cross.
Taps a length ball down to covers and steals a single.
Short and wide outside off, Singh flashes and misses.
Naseem clocks 90 mph and delivers a low full toss outside off, Vikramjit Singh pushes it without much timing to covers.
Swing and a miss! Short in length and wide outside off at 88 mph, Singh flashes his bat at it but fails to connect.
Around middle, on a length, Singh helps it with gentle hands towards mid-wicket. Another run is taken. 13 from this over.
Angling in from a length around middle, Wesley Barresi flicks it in front of square leg for one. Gets off the mark.
Full and wide outside off, driven through cover-point for one.
EDGY FOUR! Back of a length, around off and angling away, Singh pushes inside the line and edges it through the gap between first and wide second slip fielders for a boundary.
A touch short again, around leg at 86 mph, Singh flicks it through square leg and picks up a couple.
FOUR! Fine shot! Fraction short and outside off, Vikramjit Singh hangs on the back foot and crunches it through cover-point for a cracking boundary.
Beauty to end a splendid first over in ODI cricket from Naseem. A length ball, around off at 87 mph, Wesley Barresi stays back to defend but it straightens to beat the outside edge.
Play and a miss! Full in length and wide outside off, 87 mph, Barresi tries to drive but misses.
Back of a length, around off, Wesley Barresi is hurried up a bit as he keeps it out off the outer half of his bat.

Huge shout for an lbw! The finger stays down. Babar Azam consults his teammates and decides not to take the DRS. Sharp delivery, an inswinger around middle at 91 mph, Wesley Barresi tries to keep it out but misses. He is thudded on the pads. The replays later find an inside edge. Good decision from both the umpire and Babar.

OUT! Plumb in front! Fast and furious from Naseem Shah. He gets his line and length right and strikes immediately. Clocks 91 mph and delivers it on a length around off. It nips back in off the surface, Max O'Dowd is late in bringing his bat down and is pinged on the front pad. They appeal and the finger goes up instantly. Max walks back without thinking about the review. Early blow to the Netherlands.
Wesley Barresi makes his way to the middle after an early wicket.
Yet another wide down the leg side! Max tries to flick but misses. A good diving take by Rizwan.
Wide again! This time down the leg side of the right-handed batter.
Fuller in length and wide outside off, at 87 mph again, Singh reaches out and plays a mistimed drive towards wide mid off. They cross for a quick run.
Wide! Short in length but way wide outside off, at 87 mph, Singh allows it through to the keeper.
The debutant Naseem Shah has been brought on from the other end.
Angling in from a length around off, O'Dowd stays on the back foot and defends it to the leg side.
Serves it on a good length around off, at 87 mph, Max O'Dowd gets behind the line and defends it down safely.
Short and outside off, at 88 mph, Singh slices it down to third man for a run.
Beaten! A length ball, close to off and leaving the batter with the angle, Vikramjit Singh pushes inside the line and misses.
Back of a length, around off, Max runs it down to third man and opens his account with a single.

DROPPED! Put down first ball and it's a big reprieve for Vikramjit Singh. Short in length and outside off, Vikramjit Singh slaps it aerially to covers where debutant Agha Salman jumps but fails to hang on to the catch. They cross for a run.
